statistic: C-index=0.772; base=0.763; LRT p=0.107; PH min p=0.192
limitation: retrospective public data; TCGA-COAD/READ only; OS not CSS

claim: K=4 ecotype is associated with OS in discovery (exploratory, post hoc)
limitation: K=4 selected post hoc in sensitivity analysis

claim: Primary K=2 ecotype association did not replicate significantly in independent cohorts
limitation: direction consistent but not significant; cohort/platform heterogeneity

claim: K=4 exploratory association did not replicate significantly in independent cohorts
statistic: GSE39582 C-index=0.614; LRT p=0.090; GSE17536 C-index=0.772; LRT p=0.200
limitation: K=4 was post hoc; no significant replication

claim: Single-cell reference resolves six CRC lineages and supports descriptive TCGA deconvolution
statistic: 63,689 cells; 6 lineages; mean fractions epithelial 0.546, stromal 0.267, myeloid 0.123, B 0.044, T 0.015, mast 0.006
limitation: marker-based NNLS fractions are relative, not absolute; the RNA+celltype K=5 solution (classifier CV 0.553) was not retained

claim: The frozen K=2 ecotypes are largely reproducible at the protein level in CPTAC-COAD
statistic: mRNA vs protein ecotype agreement 83.3%; ARI 0.439; median programme r=0.40; IFN-alpha r=0.87; IFN-gamma r=0.81; EMT r=0.71
limitation: different cohort from TCGA; protein covers 8,067 genes; OS underpowered (8 events); Hallmark symbol sets are mapped offline with org.Hs.eg.db (msigdbr release data unavailable), which flips 2 of 96 borderline assignments versus the earlier msigdbr run (agreement 85.4%, ARI 0.496); programme-level correlations and the Cox fit are unchanged E3 here means transcriptome + proteome convergence only: the spatial arm did NOT converge (F08), so this grade does not imply the transcriptome+proteome+spatial/clinical convergence that Analysis_Plan.md describes for E3.

claim: The K=2 ecotype does not reproduce at the DNA-methylation level
statistic: ARI RNA ecotype vs methylation cluster 0.006; 5/19,269 promoter genes at FDR<0.05 and |logFC|>0.5; global beta p=0.113; CIMP-high 74.5% E1 vs 84.3% E2
limitation: 450K covers promoters only; 393 of 624 tumours had methylation data
next_test: methylation-aware programme scoring or EPIC data

claim: The bulk K=2 ecotype classifier does not transfer to Visium spots; spatial data are descriptive only
statistic: 16 sections / 43,818 spots; simplified-statistic self-check on bulk ARI 0.042 (agreement 0.604); all spots fall on one side of the decision boundary; spot E2-programme scores ~5 SD below bulk
limitation: 55 um spots mix cell types and lack bulk compartment structure; classifier trained on bulk cannot be projected
next_test: train a spot-level classifier on single-cell/spatial data

claim: The frozen K=2 ecotypes reproduce at the phosphoproteome level in CPTAC-COAD
statistic: phospho vs protein ecotype agreement 87.5%; ARI 0.558; permutation p=0.000999 (null 95th pct 0.033); median programme r phospho-protein 0.22; 538/11334 sites FDR<0.05 & |logFC|>0.5; 276 genes phospho/protein discordant at FDR<0.05
limitation: 59.8% of sites missing before filtering; kinase-activity inference not performed (no offline substrate library); OS not estimable (8 deaths); 49 of 50 programmes recoverable
next_test: kinase-substrate activity scoring (KSEA/decoupleR) once an annotation library is available

claim: The frozen K=2 ecotypes are associated with disease-free survival (DFS/RFS) in discovery and in independent cohorts
statistic: discovery GSE14333 adjusted HR=2.37 (1.27-4.4) p=0.00429; replication GSE39582 stage I-III HR=1.5 (1.07-2.1), p=0.0181; GSE17536 HR=2.51 p=0.022; fixed-effect HR=1.67 (1.24-2.24) p=0.000742, heterogeneity p=0.21
contradicting_evidence: OS association remains null in discovery (F01) and in OS validation (F03): the ecotype predicts recurrence, not death
limitation: disease-free endpoints only (DFS in GSE14333, RFS in GSE39582/GSE17536: related but not identical definitions); GSE14333 has no stage IV, GSE39582 stages I-III in the primary model; GSE39582 was already used for OS validation; observational, no treatment adjustment; never pooled with OS
next_test: GSE38832 DFS once its series matrix is available; prospective evaluation

claim: A subset of kinases shows ecotype-associated activity that is not explained by kinase abundance (inferred)
statistic: 78 kinases tested (>=5 measured substrates); 9 at FDR<0.05; 5 with unchanged kinase abundance; activity-vs-abundance r=0.31; top: CDK7, ROCK1, PRKG1, DYRK1A, CDK4
limitation: activity inferred from substrate phosphorylation, not measured; PhosphoSitePlus coverage biased and substrates shared across kinases; single cohort; no external phosphoproteome
next_test: kinase-activity assay or phosphoproteome cohort with matched abundance; replicate in an independent CPTAC-like dataset

claim: E2-defining programmes are spatially autocorrelated at spot resolution and co-localise with the stromal compartment, but are not more spatially structured than other Hallmark programmes
statistic: 800 section x programme tests; 800 at permutation p<0.05 (ceiling effect at ~2,570 spots/section); mean Moran's I E2= 0.528 vs other= 0.587 (E2 not higher); median rho E2-stromal= 0.49, E2-myeloid= 0.04
contradicting_evidence: bulk classifier still does not transfer to spots (F08) - no spot-level ecotype label is claimed; E2 programmes are no more autocorrelated than other Hallmark programmes
limitation: no outcome data; NNLS deconvolution unregularised; 55 um spots mix cells; single platform; per-section scaling used only for spatial statistics; permutation p-values at the ceiling because of spot counts
next_test: cell2location deconvolution at GPU scale; spatial cohort with matched outcome
